plan.purpose: Separately registered terminal grip refinement after development case15 meets pose/rest but fails original opposed-normal gate; no relabeling, neural training or hardware
plan.source_selection: Empirically selected partial development event, not an independent test: all final1s pose/rest/spans met but native success false due normal dot-.3826835. Preserve all12 earlier failures
plan.static_isolation: One freshly executed source grasp prefix supplies the exact randomized model, matching parent signature. On a NEW MjData only, load recorded final qpos/qvel and score hypothetical joint deltas at the unchanged recorded object pose. No mj_step, live state injection, velocity clearing, force application, model editing or task credit. Entire live signature unchanged before/after grid
plan.static_bounds: Only modified actual-joint targets must be in original ROM. All4 modified command knots must remain within original ROM and +/-0.3rad from original prefix command; never clip an invalid grid candidate into a different one
plan.static_admission: No excluded support, self/object overlap<=2mm, positive-normal-force thumb_dp/middle_ip contacts, minimum normal dot<=-0.5. Static solver forces are proposal screening only, not equilibrium, force closure or full-task acceptance
plan.static_ranking: score=(max(0,dot+0.7)/0.2)^2+0.05mean((delta/0.08)^2)+0.1(object_penetration/0.002)^2. Stable grid-order tie break. Freeze at most3 admitted candidates before physical trials; no additional grid or looser threshold if none admitted
plan.execution: Original four IK command knots, terminal delta weights0/0/0.5/1 at1.25/2.5/3.75/5s; hold5..7s. Every physical trial independently executes original reach/manual release/frozen7s grasp, exact parent prefix signature required. Original controller/delays/all2ms limits and native15deg/7s success unchanged
plan.physical_budget: One prefix-only static preparation, one original partial-trajectory reference, up to3 frozen static candidates, then2 development transfers of the selected delta: at most7 cases/6 continuations. If no static candidate, retain reference failure and skip candidates/transfers without retry
plan.selection_and_transfer: Select once by unchanged rotation_trajectory.trajectory_cost on physical source-state results, with per-tick handoff displacement and terminal delta for regularization. Freeze delta before transfers; each transfer uses that state's original parent points+normals/fixed-center plan plus the same delta. Infeasible transfer command bounds count as skipped failure, no clipping or reoptimization
plan.quality: Original native fullSO3<8deg, final1s loaded opposite thumb/middle dot<=-0.5, adequate force, velocity and2deg/2mm span gates; penetration<=2mm, force<=10weights, release displacement<4cm, vision/ROM/controller gates unchanged
plan.limits: Development tuning of one partial event with two previously seen non-search development states, positive direction only. No formal100-case, policy, continuous-rotation or sim2real acceptance; no automatic PPO/BC or budget extension

video.scope: All recorded continuations in original order; geometry only, labels from original task. No force re-evaluation or policy/hardware acceptance.

interpretation.result: One of3 preselected source-state candidates passed native15deg/7s, and the frozen selected delta passed one of2 non-search development transfers. Other candidate and transfer failures all preserved. This is not an independent2/3 success estimate.
interpretation.mechanism_evidence: Selected delta is only middle_abd=-0.08rad at terminal knots, preserving the original early trajectory and all native thresholds. Source reference reproduces exact prior failure; candidate final normal dot improves from-.3827 to-.7071 while fullSO3 error stays under8deg.
interpretation.limits: Three previously seen development states, positive direction, privileged contact IK templates plus deterministic trajectories. Existing neural policy formal0/100 unchanged; no learned rotation policy or continuous/hardware acceptance claimed.
interpretation.next_step: Collect fixed-budget native-gated demonstrations on new training seeds, preserve failures and keep fresh development/formal seeds separate; then test imitation initialization and bounded closed-loop RL. No training job launched in this experiment.
